THE APPROACH

Understand first.
Configure with confidence.

01 / THE CONCEPT

Know what each layer does.

Separate the interface, inference, knowledge and actions. A clear mental model makes every setting easier to understand.

02 / THE PRACTICE

Learn with your own setup.

Read a Compose file, inspect a running model and try a focused prompt. Make the ideas concrete, one step at a time.

03 / THE CHECKPOINT

Be able to explain your choices.

Each chapter ends with questions. Keep going when you understand why your configuration works.

START AT THE BEGINNING

The best first step
is the whole picture.
